title: Political wisdom – not just for the UK
excerpt: From Adam Dyer, here. Quotable: ‘I hope that our leaders across the United Kingdom realise the disastrous consequences for our way of life and the integrity of our United Kingdom if they continue to appeal to grievance rather than generosity and fear rather than hope’

From Adam Dyer, here.
